newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Commission worries on BA deal not only on slots.
newsitem.headline: Commission worries on BA deal not only on slots.

text.p: Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert said on Wednesday that concerns about British Airway's planned alliance with AMR Corporation's American Airlines went further than just airport slots.
"There are other issues involved," Van Miert told a news conference in reply to reporters' questions, though without giving details.

He repeated recent threats to challenge the alliance in the European Court of Justice if Britain went ahead with its own approval of the deal without taking into account European Commission worries about competition issues.
"If our competition concerns cannot be met that will mean that the alliance will be in an illegal situation in the European Union...and we will take the case to the European court," Van Miert said.
He added that the Commission had told the British government of its concerns long before sending its letter to Britain's Department of Trade and Industry earlier this month.

A report by Britain's Office of Fair Trading gave the deal provisional approval subject to a condition that British Airways and American gave up 168 weekly take-off and landing slots at London Heathrow.
Their competitors have sought more like 400 slots.
